title: Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Lookahead Information Via Adaptive Batching
abstract: arXiv:2601.10418v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study tabular finite-horizon reinforcement learning problems with multiple steps of lookahead information. Before acting, the learner observes $\ell$ steps of future transition and reward realizations: the exact state the agent would reach and the rewards it would collect under any possible course of action. While it has been shown that such information can drastically boost the value, finding the optimal policy is NP-hard, and it is common to apply one of two tractable heuristics: processing the lookahead in chunks of predefined sizes ('fixed batching policies'), and model predictive control. We first illustrate the problems with these two approaches and propose utilizing the lookahead in adaptive (state-dependent) batches; we refer to such policies as adaptive batching policies (ABPs). translated_title: 基于自适应分批的多步前瞻信息强化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有多步前瞻信息的表格型有限时域强化学习问题。在采取行动之前，学习者能够观察到ℓ步的未来转移和奖励实现情况：即在任何可能的行动方案下，智能体将会到达的精确状态以及将获得的奖励。尽管已有研究表明此类信息可以大幅提升价值，但寻找最优策略是NP难问题，因此通常采用两种可处理的启发式方法之一：以预定义大小的分块处理前瞻信息（“固定分批策略”），或模型预测控制。我们首先阐明了这两种方法存在的问题，进而提出以自适应的（依赖状态的）批次来利用前瞻信息；我们将此类策略称为自适应分批策略（ABPs）。我们推导了这类策略的最优Bellman方程，并设计了一种乐观的遗憾最小化算法，从而实现学习……
tldr: 该论文针对多步前瞻强化学习中寻找最优策略为NP难的问题，提出自适应分批策略（ABP），推导出其最优Bellman方程，并设计了乐观的遗憾最小化学习算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes adaptive batching policies (ABPs) for reinforcement learning with multi-step lookahead information, derives their optimal Bellman equations, and designs an optimistic regret-minimizing algorithm to address the NP-hardness of finding optimal policies.
